ns2:course.label: Organizational Theory for Educational Leaders
ns2:course.description: Study of theoretical perspectives and empirical research drawn from the social sciences relating to educational organizations and administrative leadership with an emphasis on application of theory to practice. Same as EOL 549. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as EOL 549. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
